scope: All-island planning authority directory; Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland are distinct jurisdictions

authorities.name: Carlow County Council
authorities.verification_note: The official Carlow County Council website links to a dedicated "Weekly Planning Notices" page for PDF lists and uses the ePlan system for application searches.

authorities.name: Cavan County Council
authorities.verification_note: Official council planning pages were verified to link directly to the ePlanning search portal, a dedicated weekly list page with downloadable ZIP files, and comprehensive application guidance.

authorities.name: Clare County Council
authorities.verification_note: Official council website planning section provides direct links to an ePlanning search portal, weekly PDF lists, and comprehensive application guidance.

authorities.name: Cork County Council
authorities.verification_note: The official council website provides a dedicated section for weekly planning lists in PDF format and links to an Agile Applications portal for public record searches.

authorities.name: Donegal County Council
